finding: The retained CICIoT2023 representation contains strongly scenario-dependent packet-window regimes. Selected benign, reconnaissance, and web-attack sources overwhelmingly use Number=10, while selected DDoS sources overwhelmingly use Number=100.
publication_consistency: The CICIoT2023 publication states that extracted feature values were grouped using packet-window sizes of 10 and 100 to mitigate data-size discrepancy between traffic scenarios.
deployment_limitation: No authoritative class-independent online rule for selecting the 10-packet versus 100-packet aggregation regime has been established. Therefore an unlabeled live extractor cannot be claimed to reproduce the Exp009 training representation exactly.
rate_iat_limitation: Rate and IAT are strongly related empirically but an exact reciprocal identity is not supported across the retained dataset.
decision: Do not connect the frozen Exp009 model directly to live traffic under a claim of exact CICIoT2023 semantic equivalence.
next_step: Develop a deployment-compatible detector using a single class-independent live feature/window policy, then evaluate that detector in a separate real-time detection and mitigation experiment.
